standalone.purpose: Default manifest generator reads pilot JSON and hashes oracle source bytes into an isolated generated manifest. Paired normal and observed runs passed; unchanged measured inputs only. No generated-output, Lean execution, semantic-test or proof credit.

Default final-manifest generator reads the retained full manifest and hashes oracle source bytes. Paired normal/observed invocations passed in an isolated checkout. Exact unchanged inputs only; no generated-output, Lean execution, semantic or proof credit.

Default h55 Lean module census enumerates and SHA256-hashes every tracked Lean path. Paired normal and observed runs passed; exact unchanged byte reads only. No elaboration, Lean check, semantic-test or proof credit.

Default bulk-run checker reads the retained BULK.json run record and reports mismatches. Paired normal and observed runs passed; exact unchanged input only. No Lean execution, oracle rerun or proof credit.
